verdict.rationale: Vonage Video API is a SaaS communications platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack shows client libraries, server-side SDKs, webhooks and an llms.txt file, but nothing about an official MCP server that an agent could connect to. The llms.txt is an adjacent documentation aid for LLMs and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
